s.how: Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg and 250ml buttermilk. Pat 8 franks dry and push onto sticks. Dip in the batter and fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Serve with mustard.

s.note: chips and lollies in the back seat
s.how: Tip a big bag of potato chips, 200g pretzels and 300g mixed lollies into a cardboard box lined with paper. Pass it into the back seat and try to make it last longer than the first hour of the drive.

m.how: Cut a 1.5kg brisket point into 4cm cubes and rub with smoked paprika and salt. Roast at 140C for 3 hours. Toss with 200ml barbecue sauce and 2 tbsp brown sugar and return to the oven for 30 minutes until sticky.

w.note: the park, finally, if it's open
w.how: Push sticks into 4 apples. Boil 400g sugar, 125ml water and 1 tsp vinegar to 150C, then add a few drops of red colouring. Dip and twirl the apples and set on baking paper. Serve with a bag of fairy floss.

d.note: the Family Truckster across the country
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Mix with the juice of 5 lemons and 1L cold water. Pour into a big thermos packed with ice and drink it from cups in the car.
